items.title: Missing Option Explicit
items.description: The module does not declare Option Explicit.

items.title: Select usage
items.description: Select makes behavior depend on Excel selection state.

items.title: Activate usage
items.description: Activate makes behavior depend on Excel active-object state.

items.title: Broad On Error Resume Next
items.description: On Error Resume Next is used without a narrow recovery scope.

items.title: Implicit Variant
items.description: A declaration omits an explicit As type.

items.title: Public module field
items.description: A module-level Public variable exposes mutable global state.

items.title: Automation-hostile GUI boundary
items.description: The source invokes an interactive boundary that can block automation.

items.title: Typographic quote
items.description: A typographic quote can trigger an Excel VBE compile dialog.

items.title: C-style quote escape
items.description: A C-style escaped quote is invalid VBA string syntax.

items.title: Unterminated procedure
items.description: A Sub, Function, or Property procedure has no matching terminator.

items.title: Unexpected procedure terminator
items.description: An End procedure statement has no matching opener.

items.title: Mismatched procedure terminator
items.description: A procedure is closed with the wrong End statement kind.

items.title: Invalid line continuation
items.description: A line-continuation underscore is not preceded by whitespace.

items.title: Parser recovery
items.description: The parser recovered from an error, missing node, or unmatched source structure.

items.title: Continuation limit exceeded
items.description: A VBA logical line exceeds the supported continuation-line limit.

items.title: Scope shadowing
items.description: A declaration shadows another visible declaration or procedure.

items.title: Mixed declarator typing
items.description: A multi-name declaration explicitly types only some declarators.

items.title: Unused local variable
items.description: A procedure-local variable is declared but never referenced.

items.title: Unused private procedure
items.description: A private procedure is unreachable from known project roots.

items.title: Confusing call syntax
items.description: A parenthesized procedure call uses ambiguous VBA call syntax.

items.title: Invalid For Each control type
items.description: A For Each control variable is undeclared or incompatible.

items.title: Dangerous Resume
items.description: Resume is used outside a recognizable error-handler context.

items.title: Ambiguous nested With member
items.description: An implicit Excel member inside nested With blocks has an ambiguous target.

items.title: Bare dialog call with XlflowUI
items.description: A bare dialog call can bind to an incompatible XlflowUI member.

items.title: Undeclared variable
items.description: Option Explicit is present but a referenced assignment or loop variable is undeclared.

items.title: Argument mismatch
items.description: A procedure call argument does not match the resolved signature.

items.title: Missing module name attribute
items.description: A standard module lacks its exported Attribute VB_Name declaration.

items.title: Repeated Debug.Print shorthand
items.description: Repeated question-mark shorthand is invalid VBA syntax.

items.title: Unknown member
items.description: A member is not present on the resolved receiver type.

items.title: Read-only property assignment
items.description: An assignment targets a read-only property.

items.title: Write-only property read
items.description: An expression reads a write-only property.

items.title: Set required
items.description: An object assignment omits the Set keyword.

items.title: Set not allowed
items.description: A value assignment incorrectly uses the Set keyword.

items.title: Incompatible assignment
items.description: The assigned expression is incompatible with the resolved target type.

items.title: Method has no return value
items.description: A method without a return value is used as an expression.

items.title: Unknown documented parameter
items.description: A documentation comment names a parameter that the procedure does not declare.

items.title: Duplicate documented parameter
items.description: A documentation comment lists the same parameter more than once.

items.title: Returns documentation on Sub
items.description: A Sub procedure documentation comment contains a Returns section.

items.title: Orphan documentation comment
items.description: A documentation comment is not associated with a declaration.

items.title: Procedure-name constant mismatch
items.description: A configured procedure-name string constant differs from its enclosing procedure name.

items.title: Object assignment missing Set
items.description: An object variable assignment likely omits Set.

items.title: Object-returning call assignment missing Set
items.description: An object-returning function assignment likely omits Set.

items.title: Object function return missing Set
items.description: An object-returning function body likely assigns its return without Set.

items.title: Excel object member mismatch
items.description: A known Excel object does not provide the referenced member.

items.title: Removed XlflowLog helper
items.description: The source calls the removed XlflowLog trace helper.

items.title: Removed XlflowSetTraceFile helper
items.description: The source calls the removed XlflowSetTraceFile trace helper.

items.title: Unchecked Range.Find result
items.description: A Range.Find result is dereferenced before a Nothing check.

items.title: Object use before Set
items.description: An object variable may be used before an obvious Set assignment.

items.title: Application state not restored
items.description: An Application state change can reach an exit without restoring its previous value.

items.title: Error-handler fallthrough
items.description: Normal execution can fall through into an error-handler label.

items.title: Ambiguous Excel object scope
items.description: Active UI objects, unqualified worksheet members (Range, Cells, Rows, and Columns), unqualified sheet collections, positional workbook/window access, uncaptured Workbooks.Open calls, and add-in ThisWorkbook references can target an unintended workbook or worksheet.

items.title: Unsafe ByRef argument
items.description: A resolved project-local ByRef call receives an incompatible type, a temporary value, or an indirect property, member, or array expression whose mutation may be lost or surprising.

items.title: Unguarded keyed access
items.description: Dictionary or Collection item access has no obvious existence guard.

items.title: Invalid ReDim Preserve dimension
items.description: ReDim Preserve is used on a multi-dimensional array.

items.title: Object or array comparison mistake
items.description: An object or array is compared with scalar equality semantics.

items.title: Missing Function or Property Get return assignment
items.description: A Function or Property Get may reach normal exit without a valid return assignment on every path.

items.title: Expanded Excel member mismatch
items.description: Expanded Excel type metadata proves an object/member mismatch.

items.title: Non-short-circuit object guard
items.description: A Nothing or IsArray guard and a matching object, index, bound, or resolved side-effecting getter access share an eagerly evaluated And, Or, IIf, Choose, or Switch expression.

items.title: Dictionary iteration value misuse
items.description: A Dictionary key yielded by direct iteration is used as a value or object.

items.title: Leaked On Error Resume Next scope
items.description: On Error Resume Next remains active across an unsafe procedure scope.

items.title: Omitted stateful Excel call arguments
items.description: A Range.Find or Range.Replace call omits settings that Excel saves and can reuse from prior UI operations or macro calls.

items.title: Worksheet root mismatch
items.description: A range expression combines explicit objects rooted in different worksheets.

items.title: Unstable last-row boundary
items.description: A last-row calculation depends on an implicit worksheet root or a boundary pattern that can produce unstable results.

items.title: Unhandled Excel API failure contract
items.description: An Excel API call can raise a runtime error or return Variant/Error when no result exists, but its failure contract is not handled.

items.title: Unreleased workbook or VBA file handle
items.description: A procedure-local Workbook or VBA file handle acquired by an explicit Open call can reach an exit without a matching Close.

items.title: Event handler re-entry hazard
items.description: An Excel or UserForm event handler can trigger itself or a related event without a proven safe event guard.

items.title: Application state changed by local helper
items.description: A direct project-local call can leave an Application property changed because the callee does not restore it on every exit.

items.title: Public API type safety
items.description: A public API declaration or exposed type uses an inaccessible, ambiguous, or unresolved type.

items.title: Likely hardcoded secret
items.description: A credential-like value appears directly in VBA source.

items.title: Untrusted data reaches a sensitive API
items.description: Conservative procedure-local analysis found potentially untrusted data flowing into a sensitive API.

items.title: Excel cell access inside loop
items.description: A loop repeatedly accesses Excel cells or related object-model members, causing avoidable COM round trips.

items.title: Unsafe Range.Value array shape assumption
items.description: A Range.Value or Range.Value2 result is consumed as a scalar or one-dimensional array, or assigned to an incompatible range shape.

items.title: Array lifecycle and dimension safety
items.description: An array may be unallocated, accessed with an invalid dimension or bound, or used without a provable array value; real-time array-return summaries are limited to the active document.

items.title: Deterministic argument binding error
items.description: A resolved procedure call has a deterministic argument-count or named-argument compile error.

items.title: ByRef type mismatch
items.description: A resolved project-local ByRef call passes a statically incompatible argument type that the VBE rejects at compile time.

items.title: Unresolved local As type name
items.description: A procedure-local declaration uses a VBA type name that cannot be resolved from the project or production type database.

items.title: Dictionary CompareMode changed after insertion
items.description: A Dictionary CompareMode is changed after entries have been added to the same dictionary instance.

items.title: Repeated Dictionary loop materialization
items.description: Dictionary Keys or Items is repeatedly materialized inside a loop instead of being cached or enumerated once.

items.title: Inconsistent Dictionary key normalization
items.description: The same Dictionary key source is used with inconsistent raw, case-normalized, or trimmed forms.

items.title: Undefined late-bound Dictionary constant
items.description: A late-bound Dictionary CompareMode uses a Scripting enum constant that is not defined in the project.

items.title: Collection mutation during iteration
items.description: A Collection is mutated while a For Each loop is iterating the same collection instance.

items.title: Collection index origin confusion
items.description: A one-based Collection is accessed with a zero index or an unadjusted zero-based loop or array index.

items.title: Unsafe command construction
items.description: A process-launch command may combine external input, an unquoted executable path, secrets, or unobserved execution.

items.title: Suppressed error propagation
items.description: A procedure or call boundary loses failure information by returning normally without rethrowing, returning a success flag that the caller ignores, or otherwise failing to signal failure.
